<description>
`verify_shasums_signature` previously separated signatures into `good_trusted` and `good_untrusted`, but computed `num_trusted = len(good_trusted) + len(good_untrusted)`. As a result, 3 valid signatures from untrusted keys present in the local GPG keyring satisfied `--min-good-sigs` even when none of them were trusted in GPG or matched `--trusted-keys`.

In addition, `README.md` documents passing full 40-character primary key fingerprints to `--trusted-keys`, whereas `parse_gpg_result` only recorded the key identifier from `GOODSIG` and ignored `VALIDSIG` fingerprints, did not deduplicate multiple signatures from the same primary key, and still counted `REVKEYSIG` entries toward the threshold.

Changes:
- Count only distinct, non-revoked trusted signers toward `--min-good-sigs`.
- Parse signing and primary key fingerprints from GnuPG `VALIDSIG` status lines so `--trusted-keys` matches full fingerprints while deduplicating by primary key fingerprint.
- Clarify the trust requirement in `contrib/verify-binaries/README.md`.
- Add unit tests in `contrib/verify-binaries/test.py` (`python3 -m unittest contrib/verify-binaries/test.py -v`).
</description>
